instruction: Candid street photograph, medium shot. On a city sidewalk with row houses, the woman with short curly hair and glasses (R1) on the left walks hand-in-hand with the person with short dark undercut hair (R2) on the right. R1, wearing an olive parka and purple leggings, looks happily at R2. R2, in a black denim jacket and green pants, walks alongside, holding R1's hand and carrying a towel and water bottle. Soft natural daylight illuminates the casual outdoor scene.
